build_MidasCore: build a MidasCore model from a pretrained MiDaS model type like DPT_BEiT_L_384
build_MidasCore_from_config: build a MidasCore model by passing a config dictionary with model type and training options
create_Resize_transform: create a Resize transform that resizes tensors to a target width and height with aspect ratio control
create_PrepForMidas_transform: create a PrepForMidas transform that normalizes and resizes input tensors for MiDaS model inference
use_denormalize: use the denormalize function to reverse ImageNet normalization on a torch tensor
